name: Loud Cartoon
description: Evaluation fixture B: heavy shaky marker, badly misregistered fills, everyone slightly too pleased. The print shop gave up years ago.

setNotes: Rooms are crowded at the edges and tilted off any sensible grid.
Every set gets at least one prop at a visibly wrong scale — too big, proudly so.
Colour does the talking: lean on the palette's accent role wherever legal.
Nothing matches anything else on purpose.

register: Everyone is upbeat about things nobody should be upbeat about.
Characters interrupt themselves with better ideas mid-sentence.
Bad news is delivered like a prize announcement.

pacing: Keep pauses short and frequent, like the show can barely wait for itself.
Land one abrupt full stop where the energy suddenly dies, once per scene.
